purpose: Measure the real Tokenoskobi main pipeline inner speed by placing a marked local water-drop probe and observing how far it travels through active runtime/readmodel/panel paths.
why: Previous N5 results measured boot/control speed, not source-to-readmodel-to-panel hot-path latency.

decision_rules.drop_does_not_reach_readmodel: pipeline may be timer-driven, inactive, or not wired for probe input
decision_rules.service_timer_active_but_no_drop: active schedule exists but probe path missing or wrong inlet
